newsitem.title: USA: USDATA product development exec resigns.
newsitem.headline: USDATA product development exec resigns.

text.p: USDATA Corp said Tuesday that Ken Whitaker resigned from his position as senior vice president, product development.
The company said in a statement that he left to "pursue other career opportunities." USDATA said it will immediately begin to search for a replacement.
USDATA is a supplier of real-time application development tools, distribution management software, automatic identification equipment and related consulting and integration services.
